description:
List your alert rules

Returns the alert rules owned by the signed-in wallet, newest first, each with its token, alert type, threshold, cooldown and whether it is enabled. A rule's `id` is what update, toggle and delete take. Narrows to one token with BOTH `chainId` and `tokenAddress`; a `symbol` is refused with 400 `invalid_filter` (one ticker can name several tokens), and narrowing needs both of the pair. Rules belong to the wallet signed in with, not to the whole account: a rule made from another linked wallet is not listed here.

Needs Sign in with Chain Daddy (scope api:read).

chainId.description: Narrow to one token. Chain key (`base`), numeric id or CAIP-2 id. Send together with `tokenAddress`.

tokenAddress.description: Narrow to one token (0x address on EVM, mint on Solana). Send together with `chainId`.

name: list_alert_rules

alert_type.description:
What the rule watches, and the lowest plan that may create it: `heartbeat_score` (Free, EVM only, needs a
token page), `copycat_detected` (Free, needs a token page), `holder_count_drop`, `liquidity_drop`,
`volume_anomaly`, `price_change` (Pro), `top10_concentration` (Pro+).

cooldown_minutes.description: Minutes before this rule may fire again

symbol.description: The token's ticker, for display only (may be empty when unreadable)

threshold_operator.description:
`gt` / `lt`: the metric is above / below `thresholdValue`. `pct_drop` / `pct_spike`: the metric fell / rose by
at least `thresholdValue` percent. `top10_concentration` accepts only `gt` and `pct_spike`.

tier_required.description: Lowest plan this alert type needs

title: List my alert rules
